import json,os
needles=[b'172.30.145.189',b'\xac\x1e\x91\xbd']
paths=['store/jobs/j000049/out/proc/pid.3768.dmp','store/jobs/j000079/out/pid.1576.dmp']

 hits=[[] for _ in needles];pos=0;tail=b''
 with open(path,'rb') as f:
  while True:
   chunk=f.read(8*1024*1024)
   if not chunk:break
   data=tail+chunk;base=pos-len(tail)
   for i,n in enumerate(needles):
    start=0

     k=data.find(n,start)
     if k<0:break
     off=base+k
     if off>=0 and (not hits[i] or off!=hits[i][-1]):hits[i].append(off)
     start=k+1
   pos+=len(chunk);tail=data[-(max(map(len,needles))-1):]
 out.append({'path':path,'length':pos,'hits':{n.hex():hs for n,hs in zip(needles,hits)}})
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
open(os.path.join(os.environ['OUT'],'process-hit-offsets.json'),'w').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
